decisions.reason: Product A is close to the established offer, has remained on its own page for two years, and keeping the option open costs little, so it is likely kept.
Product B is still early, close to the established offer, and shows no negative signal, so the option is kept open while uncertainty about its value resolves.
Like Product B, Product C is a low-cost option close to the core business and still uncertain, so the firm is unlikely to abandon it within a year.
